answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 38144 Country: AF Title: Every Friday we go to village for picnic and stay there from morning to evening Question: Every Friday we go to village for picnic and stay there from morning to evening. May I know will it be a sin for us according to Shariah to leave Jumuah salah? Answer ID: 38144 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 695/605/B=1433) It is bad to go to village on Friday and leave Friday prayer merely for picnic while Jumuah is an important salah. You should choose any other day for picnic or first offer Jumuah and then leave for village for picnic. Note: The answer is correct. It is also necessary that the picnic is free from other prohibited things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
